newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex unit sells catering interests.
newsitem.headline: Vendex unit sells catering interests.

text.p: Abilis, a unit of retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Wednesday it was selling its catering interests to Generale de Restauration, part of Generale des Eaux.
"The sale of this stake in the catering businesses fits in with Abilis's strategy of concentrating on core activities: general and specialised cleaning," Abilis said in a statement.
The French group already owned 50 percent of the Restoplan and Le Grand Bernand catering businesses, but the sale will raise its stake rise to 100 percent.
Restoplan's 1995/1996 turnover was around 60 million guilders. That of Le Grand Bernard was about 15 million guilders.
British food services company Compass Group Plc last month also took an 11.17 percent stake in Generale de Restauration.
